features: 📷 360° Panoramic HD Camera – Wide-angle fisheye lens provides full room coverage with clear HD video, eliminating blind spots for complete home monitoring.
🎙️ Two-Way Audio Communication – Built-in microphone and speaker allow real-time listening and talking through the camera for family interaction or visitor alerts.
🌙 Night Vision Support – Infrared LEDs ensure clear video even in complete darkness, providing 24/7 security monitoring.
🚨 Motion Detection Alerts – Smart motion sensing sends instant notifications to your phone when movement is detected.
📱 Remote Live View & App Control – Monitor your home anytime, anywhere using your smartphone via dedicated mobile app (Android & iOS supported).
💡 Easy Bulb Installation (E27/B22) – Simply screw into a standard light socket no wiring or drilling required. Works like a normal bulb with added security.
description: Upgrade your home security with this innovative smart light bulb camera, designed to combine bright LED lighting with discreet, full-coverage indoor surveillance. Simply screw it into any standard light socket and monitor your home in real time directly from your smartphone. Featuring a 360-degree panoramic wide-angle lens, this camera eliminates blind spots and provides a complete view of any room. The HD video quality delivers clear, detailed footage, while motion detection technology instantly alerts you when movement is detected, helping you stay informed and protected at all times. The camera connects easily via WiFi and is controlled through a user-friendly mobile app, allowing you to view live video, review recordings, and manage settings remotely. Its hidden-in-plain-sight light bulb design makes it ideal for indoor use. No complicated wiring or professional installation is required just screw it in, connect to WiFi, and start monitoring. This all-in-one lighting and security solution is perfect for homeowners, renters, and small businesses looking for smart, reliable indoor surveillance.
